# Night audit

The night auditor closes the shift report before midnight.

Breaks are unpaid; overtime is approved by the property manager.

| Role          | Duty                                    |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| Night auditor | Closes the shift report before midnight |

A shift starts at eight. All shifts are approved by the manager.

It should be noted that this is basically what it is about.

Peacocks roam the orangery unsupervised.
